summary: Frontend-only test of Family Journey Phase 2 (manual SMS delivery). Ran on the Expo web preview at 375x667 as voicetest2026@example.com. Used browser-only localStorage seeding: two fake device contacts, TEST_Asha 9000000001 and TEST_Ravi 9000000002, plus a seeded overdue active journey. window.open and window.alert were stubbed so sms: links could be captured. PASSING: (1) Hub shows the notice 'You press Send — always', and the master toggle hides and shows the feature. With the toggle OFF, deep links to /active, /new, /contacts and /preview all show fj-off-screen. (2) The fj-new-preview-badge reads 'Your SMS app opens with this text — you press Send.' (3) On the contacts screen, turning each of the 3 switches ON opens fj-mode-confirm with '<name> receives this text from your number:' and the exact first-person SMS. fj-confirm-yes turns the switch on. (4) The preview screen shows the exact SMS bodies, each ending '(Sent by me from the DHARA app.)'. fj-preview-start opens /active. (5) fj-arrived opens fj-send-sheet; the old fj-message-preview did not render. The sheet has the 'DHARA cannot send a message by itself' text, the exact SMS, one row per permitted contact (arrival: c1 and c2) and a Done button. Tapping Open SMS on c2 created exactly 1 sms: link (sms:9000000002?body=...) and left c1 untouched. The row then reads 'SMS app opened — press Send there to deliver it.' and the button reads 'Open again'. Opening the composer was recorded in journey.sent. (6) The help confirm reads 'Your SMS app will open for TEST_Asha, one at a time. You press Send each time — DHARA sends nothing by itself.' Continue opens the send sheet in helpRequest mode. (7) An overdue check-in was forced by seeding startedAt 45 minutes ago. The card shows 'Tell a contact my check-in is late' and opens the send sheet, not a preview. (8) Blocked path: a contact with phone 112 shows the 'Blocked for your safety' alert, the row reads 'Nothing was opened — see the notice…', no sms: link opens and nothing is logged. (9) Regression: Women's Shield, /women/guardian-share, /women/head-out, /women/evidence-locker (PIN setup), /emergency and /women/trusted-circle all render with no page errors. Family Journey writes only fj_* keys. FAILING (truthfulness audit): /family-journey/preview still shows PREVIEW_LABEL 'Preview — nothing has been sent.' on the top badge and under every message, including after SMS composers were opened. Its bubbles are also labelled 'DHARA' as the sender, although the text goes from the student's own number. The overdue check-in card says 'Nothing has been sent…' even right after the student opened the SMS app for the late check-in. WEB LIMITATION: on web the sms: link goes through Linking.openURL → window.open (stubbed here). Success means the link was handed to the browser; real SMS delivery cannot be verified in a headless browser.

ui_bugs.issue: With FJ_SEND_ENABLED=true, preview.tsx still renders <PreviewBadge> ('Preview — nothing has been sent.') unconditionally. This covers the top badge (fj-preview-top-badge) and every per-message badge (fj-preview-badge-<mode>-<id>). It is false once the student has opened the SMS app for a contact (confirmed with the journey.sent log populated, then opening 'See all previews'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/family-journey/preview.tsx:63 and :101

Each bubble shows a shield icon plus 'DHARA' as the sender (msgFrom). In Phase 2 the SMS goes from the student's own number, so this misstates who the sender is. Reference: /app/frontend/app/family-journey/preview.tsx:94-97

When overdue, the Phase-2 copy starts 'Nothing has been sent and nothing says whether you are safe…'. It ignores journey.sent and stays the same right after the student opened the SMS app for the late check-in (sent log {device:c1:{missedCheckin}} was present). Reference: /app/frontend/app/family-journey/active.tsx:119-120

issues: The 'failed' line says 'You can copy the text above', but the bubble <Text> is not selectable, so the text cannot be copied on native. Add selectable to bubbleTxt (SendSheet.tsx:57).

action_items: preview.tsx: when FJ_SEND_ENABLED, replace PreviewBadge with PhaseBadge, or with a truthful line such as 'Nothing is sent from this screen'. PREVIEW_LABEL must not appear in Phase 2 (lines 63 and 101).
preview.tsx: in Phase 2, replace the 'DHARA' sender chip in the message bubble with 'From your number' or similar (lines 94-97).
active.tsx:120: in the Phase-2 overdue copy, remove 'Nothing has been sent', or make it depend on journey.sent (e.g. say 'You opened your SMS app for <names>' after a send).

Minor: the help-request confirm sets helpRequestedAt before any SMS is opened, so 'You opened a help request at …' still appears if the student taps Done without opening any composer, or if no contact has the permission. Consider setting it only in onSent for helpRequest.
Minor: add selectable to the SendSheet bubble text so the 'copy the text above' fallback works.
critical_code_review_comments: send.ts: the web fallback reports 'composer' whenever Linking.openURL resolves. react-native-web resolves even if window.open is popup-blocked, so the web status is optimistic. The copy says only 'SMS app opened', so this is acceptable for a preview build. On native, the expo-sms path is accurate.
SendSheet: one contact per tap is confirmed (1 sms: URL per tap, single recipient). busyId disables only the tapped row. Outcomes reset when the sheet closes.
Every dispatch goes through the outbound guard. The emergency-number rail was confirmed with 112. closed_testing rails apply to both composeSms and the sms: fallback.
Stale header comments still say '(Phase 1: Preview)' in active.tsx, index.tsx and new.tsx. This is cosmetic only.
No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch). expo-sms ~14.0.8 is in use.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (9/10 review items pass; truthfulness audit fails on preview screen + overdue card)

seed_data_creation: Browser localStorage only, no server data. Seeded fake device contacts TEST_Asha (9000000001, or 112 for the blocked test) and TEST_Ravi (9000000002), plus an fj_journey_v1_<uid> active journey. Nothing was written to MongoDB, and no user or server data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.context.add_init_script(open('/app/tests/fj/fj_init_overdue.js').read()). It sets gk_token, gk_user, gk_lang='"en"' and lang_onboarded, seeds ws_trusted_circle_<uid> with c1/c2, and seeds an active journey 45 minutes overdue. It also stubs window.open into window.__opened and window.alert into window.__alerts. The JWT in these files may expire; regenerate it via POST /api/auth/login. Contact testIDs use the 'device:' prefix, e.g. fj-send-device:c1, fj-pick-device:c1 and fj-mode-arrival-device:c1. Use fj_init_blocked.js (c1 phone=112) for the guard-blocked path.
rca_of_issue: The Phase-2 copy switch (PhaseBadge / FJ_SEND_ENABLED) was applied to hub/new/contacts/active, but preview.tsx still imports and renders PreviewBadge directly and keeps the Phase-1 'DHARA' sender chip. The overdue card's Phase-2 string kept the Phase-1 prefix 'Nothing has been sent'.
